note: Reagan County (TX) publishes no zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The only city with zoning is Big Lake, whose official Land Use (Zoning) Map (2021) is a PDF on Google Drive, not a queryable service. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the county parcel service (TNRIS/Pritchard & Abbott, token-required) found no zoning district polygons. Big Lake's zoning ordinance on eCode360 is text only.
